notes.title: 33% Off for Halloween!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/UsaL996.jpg]
Boo! Happy Halloween to all you Mages, Magicians (and magically challenged folks) out there! If you've been waiting for a good chance to try out this spooky story of magic and mind, we've got some great news to share: 

Until November 1st, One Small Fire at a Time is 33% off for the Steam Halloween Sale! Enjoy your time in the city of Overture, and don't forget to ask your nurse for some candy!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/3CWEmEo.png]
The Summer of Story is here, ushered in by One Small Fire at a Time! It's Steam Summer Sale now, so just in case you missed release week, here's another great chance to experience the story of Janis and her struggle in a world that doesn't accept her!

notes.title: Support Story Games! 15% off During Release Week
notes.content: We wanted to make sure everyone got a release sale and shot at supporting Kidalang for their first release this year! Until June 17th there's a 15% discount anyone can get for One Small Fire at a Time. Show Steam and the community you support story-based games!

notes.title: One Small Fire at a Time Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gakwNnF.png[/img]

Hello from Culture Select, and thank you for taking the time to stop by this page. We're really excited to be bringing you this great new title by Kidalang, One Small Fire at a Time! Set in a world of magic, with an eclectic cast of characters addressing some compelling mental illness issues, we trust you'll find it an insightful and thought-provoking experience!
